answer: Operator-Linked Action Ledger. Each agent action emits a signed pulse tied to its operator’s root credential, and every credential carries a pearl budget: a hard cap on distinct wallets that may act under it per epoch. Exceeding the cap freezes the entire operator credential, not just the offending wallet, and requires re-registration backed by a basalt-anchored deposit forfeited on any repeat. Cost: one lost deposit plus full credential downtime per duplicate cluster, making N identities cost N deposits rather than N cheap keys.
